notes: Stable hardware facts only, cross-checked against two independent sources: torvalds/linux (arch/m68k in-tree MCF5441x platform, GPL source cited as file/line references only) and the NetBurner NNDK's MCF5441x register headers (vendored at docs/refs/netburner-coldfire/, see its README for provenance/URL and corpus limitations). Every fact below carries its own 'source' field naming which corpus backs it -- do not assume one corpus for the whole file. See docs/refs/linux-m5441x-893e1178.md and docs/refs/netburner-mcf5441x-layout.md for full HW/QUIRK/POLICY/NEW labels, mismatches and open questions. Renamed from linux-m5441x-893e1178.json because DTIM base/register facts are now NetBurner-sourced, not Linux-sourced -- a single-vendor filename would misattribute them.

linux.clone_command: git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/torvalds/linux /tmp/linux-m5441x && cd /tmp/linux-m5441x && git checkout 893e11787f78e43b534e252249ac3fff4d1333f8 && git sparse-checkout set arch/m68k drivers/mmc/host/sdhci-esdhc-mcf.c drivers/mmc/host/sdhci-esdhc.h

netburner.limitation: headers only (declarations, macros), no .c implementation files, no reset values or behavioral documentation -- see docs/refs/netburner-coldfire/README.md

intc.icr_encoding: raw level in low 3 bits (intc-simr family, not level<<3|priority)
intc.imr_offset_note: IMRH at +0x08, IMRL at +0x0C -- NEW: not exercised by Linux's own intc-simr.c driver for this SoC (SIMR/CIMR only); NetBurner's intcstruct declares this offset independently for the same struct.

dtim.base_source_ref: arch/coldfire/cpu/MCF5441X/include/sim5441x.h:1426 (timerstruct timer[4] at 0xFC07_0000..0xFC07_FFFF, 0x4000-byte stride) -- MCF5441x-address-specific, unlike the Linux dma_timer.c reference below which only covers a sibling part (CONFIG_M523x)
dtim.register_offsets_source_ref: linux: arch/m68k/coldfire/dma_timer.c:22-27 (CONFIG_M523x DMA timer IP block, generic offsets, not m5441x-address-verified); netburner: sim5441x.h:663-674 (timerstruct: tmr/txmr/ter/trr/tcr/tcn at the same offsets, MCF5441x-specific)
dtim.trr_plus_one_status: OPEN -- neither Linux's dma_timer.c (runs DTRR0=0, free-run, never exercises reload arithmetic) nor the NetBurner headers (declarations only, no .c using trr) confirm or contradict the (DTRR+1) reload convention emu/dtim.py uses from MCF5441XRM.pdf table 39-2. Not a contract fact; recorded here so this file does not silently imply it is cross-checked.

esdhc.irq_source_note: NEW: NetBurner's own ISR table assigns eSDHC to INTC2 source 31; vector = INTC2 vector_base(192) + 31 = 223. Not stated by the Linux driver map (register layout only).
esdhc.vendor_dma_error_bit_source_ref: drivers/mmc/host/sdhci-esdhc-mcf.c:22 (ESDHC_INT_VENDOR_SPEC_DMA_ERR); deferred, not applicable to current firmware's eDMA-based transfers

edma.source_ref: arch/coldfire/cpu/MCF5441X/include/sim5441x.h:483-497,527,1404 (edmastruct, edma_tcdstruct: base 0xFC04_4000, tcd[64] at 0xFC04_5000, 0x20-byte stride, CITER at +0x14 / BITER at +0x1C -- the non-Kinetis ordering emu/edma.py's docstring already flags)
edma.note: Matches emu/edma.py's EDMA_BASE/TCD_BASE/field offsets, which were already reverse-engineered from a live firmware trace (TCD35 at 0xFC045460) and MCF5441XRM.pdf ch.23, not from Linux. NetBurner corroborates; not the origin of these constants.
